name: Owner typo trap
goal: An EXECUTE or REVIEW message with Owner set to a non-participant must be surfaced as a protocol problem instead of silently steering the task.

# Owner Typo Trap

A protocol Owner typo should be caught before it creates an ambiguous handoff.

context: The first implementation note intentionally contains an invalid owner name, buildbot. The agents must notice and correct the protocol owner to claude or codex before editing result.txt to OWNER-TYPO-PASS and asking for review.
